summary: Remote worker agent exposes network-driven PTY and shell execution on the installer's host
details: The package runs as an agent that connects to a configurable WebSocket server (default ws://localhost:3456, overridable via SERVER_URL / saved config) and dispatches server-sent messages into local shell surfaces on the installer's host. handleTerminalCreate spawns a PTY via pty.spawn(shell,...) for bash / powershell / cmd, and handleTerminalInput writes server-supplied bytes directly into that PTY's stdin. Separately, an LLM tool-call path invokes a Bash tool through runProcessImpl(invocation.command, invocation.args,...) where the command string is taken from remote tool-call input dispatched by handleMessage / handleUserInput. Whoever controls the configured WebSocket endpoint therefore obtains arbitrary shell command execution and full interactive PTY access in the process's working directory. The only gate on this surface is a shared secret sent in the WS auth message; loadConfig defaults agentSecret to the static literal 'agent-shared-secret' and index.js falls back to that default when neither AGENT_SECRET nor a saved config overrides it, so a deployment that does not set an override leaves the remote-shell surface reachable to anyone who can connect to the agent's server (or its loopback port). service/linux.js additionally prepends ~/.local/bin and ~/.npm-global/bin to PATH in shell RC files at install/setup time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
